cars.notes:
Facelift launched 24 Jul 2026. It adds a new 1.0 Boosterjet turbo-petrol (110 PS/81 kW, 170 Nm, 6MT only; about 108.5 bhp; rpm not published). Turbo is treated as each trim's base powertrain because it is the cheapest. Autocar's July launch prices are lower than CarDekho's October figures on most MT and CNG variants (e.g. LXi Turbo Rs 7.40 lakh vs Rs 7,49,900). marutisuzuki.com calls its prices 'introductory' and shows only AT prices (ZXi AT Rs 12,00,500 and ZXi+ AT Rs 13,70,500, which match CarDekho's dual-tone prices). Dual-tone variants (about Rs 15,600 extra) are not listed separately. CNG output is 88 hp/121.5 Nm (Autocar); rpm not found. Autocar marks the reverse camera, VXi alloys, cruise control, TPMS, blind-spot warning and front sensors as Boosterjet-only on lower trims. Carlelo says the VXi has wheel covers. The 1.5 VXi wheel value follows that, so it is a partly conflicting source. The head-up display on ZXi+ is from Carlelo only. CarDekho shows K15C torque as 139 Nm @4400.
Update 21 Oct 2026: Photos unchanged (facelift images on Commons appear to be Team-BHP photos with a false CC0 claim). Prices re-checked against CarDekho New Delhi and CarWale (manufacturer price pages do not render prices): all match, none changed. No mileage was missing.

cars.notes:

The April 2025 update made 6 airbags standard and added (O) trims with a panoramic sunroof, plus an 8-way power driver seat, an electronic parking brake (6AT), PM2.5 purifier and new 17-inch alloys (trim split not published). AWD moved from 5MT to 6AT. In April 2025 Autocar priced the (O) trims Rs 60,000 above the base trims. CarDekho's October 2026 list shows only about Rs 4,000 between Zeta and Zeta (O), and CarWale shows about Rs 14,000, so the (O) pricing and content should be re-checked. Prices conflict slightly: CarWale lists Zeta MT at Rs 13.75 lakh vs CarDekho Rs 13.85 lakh. Most trim feature lists are from pre-2025 variant guides, so treat them as indicative. AT mileage is 20.58 kmpl per Autocar, but CarWale's table shows 20.16. AWD AT is 19.2 kmpl, and 19.38 was the old AWD MT figure. K15C rpm figures are from earlier spec sheets (103 PS @6000, 136.8 Nm @4400), and current sources quote 139 Nm. Strong hybrid: engine 91 bhp/122 Nm, system output 114 bhp, rpm not confirmed. CNG rpm not found. Wheel sizes for hybrid trims were not confirmed. Dual-tone variants and an upcoming Phantom Blaq edition are not listed.
Update 21 Oct 2026: Photos unchanged. Prices re-checked against CarDekho New Delhi and CarWale (manufacturer price pages do not render prices): all match, none changed. No mileage was missing.
